name: multiserver.webhop.me
description:
Welcome to Ultragys's Multiserver! You can chill at this server, hang out with others, mine, roleplay, and do some PvE! Try to earn a great amount of money to unlock all areas!

Welcome! Ultragys's Multiserver has lots of stuff for you to do! You can roleplay, mine, build a plot, PvP, or just chill! Also, we have a story mode with two parts at the moment! While you are at the server please make sure you follow these rules: No harassment, no bullying, no swearing, no stealing, no begging for op, no spamming, no false reporting, no destroying plots that aren't yours, no using plots that you didn't buy, be appropriate, do not spam PVE Master's entity spawning buttons, do not ask for creative mode or op and no hacking. I try to give fair warnings and little punishments but hackers will be instantly banned and currently there is no way to appeal so please don't break the rules. This server is still a little small so please suggest anything in the suggestions area in the shop that we need to work on. I hope you enjoy your time at the server! Oh and also one last thing: This server has no mods! All vanilla!
